preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements in the list a is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= 50 for ai in as_list)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list a is between 0 and 50.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) <= 200 for s in output_lines[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each string in the output has a length between 1 and 200.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines[i][j]) == as_list[i][j] for j in range(len(as_list[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The length of the longest common prefix of consecutive strings matches the corresponding value in a.
